title: Quickstart progression tiles and annotated swipe pack for release blog and docs
creator: Maya R. Chen
description: Design an asset pack to showcase Quickstart onboarding changes in the release blog and docs. Deliverables: (1) a set of progression tiles that show step-by-step onboarding states (empty -> guided hints -> populated project), (2) an annotated swipe comparison set (before / after UI) with pixel-accurate overlays and callouts, (3) short micro-animations (3-5s) for hero hero placement and the guided onboarding highlight, (4) exported assets for blog, docs, and social (desktop, tablet, mobile crops; transparent .webp and .png variants), and (5) handoff spec and export script in Drive. Focus on clarity for product writers and engineers: label interactions, highlight what changed for performance, and include alt text snippets for accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Progression tiles: 4 states exported in 3 sizes (desktop/tablet/mobile) with consistent grid alignment
Swipe comparison: paired before/after frames for 6 screens with annotated callouts and copy snippets in the design file
Micro-animations: 3 MP4/WebM loops and Lottie JSONs for at least two hero placements
Exports: blog-ready .webp (lossy) and .png (lossless) plus transparent backgrounds for hero overlays
Handoff: Drive folder with exports, a Confluence page with usage guidance and copy snippets, and one engineering PR referencing image assets
